title: 🏖️ Academy Holiday Notice: Gandhi Jayanti Observance
message:
Dear Students & Parents,

Please note that Wits Lingo Academy and all live online classrooms will remain closed on Friday, 2nd October 2026 on the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti. No live speaking classes or teacher consultations will take place on this day.

Key Guidelines for Students:
• Self-paced vocabulary audio drills and previous session recordings will remain accessible 24/7 on your student dashboard.
• Homework submissions for Assignment 03 will have an extended deadline until 4th October 2026.
• Regular interactive live classes will resume punctually on Saturday, 3rd October as per your regular schedule.

Warm regards,
Wits Lingo Administration
author: Ziyaur Rehman Zia

title: 📢 Spoken English: 1-on-1 Mock Interview Pairs on Friday
message:
Attention Spoken English learners:

This Friday's live session (07:30 PM - 08:30 PM IST) will feature mandatory 1-on-1 mock speaking pairs and individual fluency evaluations.

Preparation Checklist:
1. Please join the live class room 5 minutes early with your video camera turned on and microphone tested.
2. Review the "100 High-Frequency Daily Dialogue Sheet" available in your study materials section.
3. Prepare a concise 2-minute introduction covering your background, professional aspirations, and daily routine.

Active participation is compulsory for monthly certificate grading.
author: Ziyaur Rehman Zia

title: 🕒 English Foundation: Timing Adjusted to 5:00 PM for Revision Week
message:
Dear Foundation students,

To allow 15 extra minutes of guided pronunciation drills, our daily evening live class will temporarily commence at 05:00 PM IST instead of 04:30 PM IST during the upcoming Revision Week (28th Sept to 2nd Oct).

Please verify your class links on the dashboard. Class duration will be 60 minutes of intensive practice.
author: Ziyaur Rehman Zia

title: 🎧 15 New Pronunciation & Tongue-Twister Audio Drills Uploaded
message:
Exciting learning update!

15 new studio-recorded audio drills focusing on removing Mother Tongue Influence (MTI), mastering 'P' vs 'B' and 'V' vs 'W' sound articulation, and connected conversational speech have been added to the Study Materials library.

All students are recommended to listen and shadow-speak for at least 10 minutes every morning.
author: Ziyaur Rehman Zia
